استألت (form X)

# اِسْتَأَلْتَ (istaʔalta) /is.ta.ʔal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَآلَ (istaʔāla)
# اِسْتَأَلْتِ (istaʔalti) /is.ta.ʔal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَآلَ (istaʔāla)
